# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea C-J4 classification check (2026-10-06 continuation). Reads the embedded
# enumeration (C-J4-SCOPE-ENUM, written by scope_enum.py to /tmp/rt3/j4/enum.json) and the two sweep
# listings (C-J4-SWEEP), and checks: (1) the per-row classes of classes.py partition rows 000-238 exactly;
# (2) the J4 (iv) class equals the set of rows tagged authority_99ce20_f0a9c7; (3) every row of the tight
# 189-row listing is in the recorded 266-row listing and every other recorded row contains a TASK-2026
# identifier; (4) the manual additions are present in the recorded listing at the stated file:line.
# Read-only. Stdlib only.
import sys, json, re, collections
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/rt3/j4/final")
from classes import CLASSES, OVERLAYS, parse

rows = json.load(open("/tmp/rt3/j4/enum.json"))["rows"]
N = len(rows)
seen = collections.Counter()
for name, ids in CLASSES.items():
    for i in parse(ids):
        seen[i] += 1
dups = sorted(i for i, c in seen.items() if c > 1)
missing = [i for i in range(N) if i not in seen]
out_of_range = sorted(i for i in seen if i >= N)
print("rows:", N, "| classes:", len(CLASSES), "| assigned:", sum(seen.values()))
print("partition: duplicates", dups, "missing", missing, "out_of_range", out_of_range,
      "->", "EXACT" if not dups and not missing and not out_of_range else "NOT A PARTITION")
print("per-class counts:", {k: len(parse(v)) for k, v in CLASSES.items()})

auth_tagged = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if "authority_99ce20_f0a9c7" in r["categories"]]
iv = parse(CLASSES["PASS-AUTHORITY-NOT-SCOPE"])
print("J4 (iv): rows tagged authority_99ce20_f0a9c7:", len(auth_tagged),
      "| class PASS-AUTHORITY-NOT-SCOPE:", len(iv), "| equal:", sorted(auth_tagged) == sorted(iv))
for name, ids in OVERLAYS.items():
    bad = [i for i in parse(ids) if i >= N]
    print("overlay", name, parse(ids), "in range:", not bad)

def listing(path):
    out = []
    for line in open(path).read().splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"^(X\d{3}) (.*)$", line)
        if m:
            out.append((m.group(1), m.group(2)))
    return out

rec = listing("/tmp/rt3/j4/sweep.out")
tight = listing("/tmp/rt3/j4/final/out/sweep.out")
rec_bodies = [b for _, b in rec]
tight_bodies = [b for _, b in tight]
extra = [b for b in rec_bodies if b not in set(tight_bodies)]
print("recorded listing rows:", len(rec), "| tight listing rows:", len(tight))
print("tight subset of recorded:", set(tight_bodies) <= set(rec_bodies),
      "| recorded minus tight:", len(extra),
      "| each of those contains a TASK-2026 identifier:", all(re.search(r"TASK-2026", b) for b in extra))
print("recorded order preserved for the tight rows:", [b for b in rec_bodies if b in set(tight_bodies)] == tight_bodies)

recd = dict(rec)
for x, loc in manual.items():
    print("manual", x, "at", loc.strip(), ":", recd.get(x, "").startswith(loc))

# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea C-J3-G4: gate G4 (CTL-INSTRUMENT-SELFTEST) at (17, 0), first stable W,
# 16 seeded RS-3 m = 2 relations; unmutated build, M1 and M2 under both CERT-BIND readings.
import json, random, time, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/rt2333ea")
from lib import *
from cell import Cell
from instr import *

t0 = time.time()
c = Cell(17, 0)
c.kerg_roots = kerg_roots(c)
info = {"cell": "(17,0)", "field_modulus": bin(c.F.M), "group_order": c.order, "factorisation": {str(p): e for p, e in c.fac.items()},
        "r": c.r, "h": c.h, "lambda": c.lam, "AR-2": c.AR2, "Phi_n_factors": [bin(f) for f in c.facs], "g": bin(c.g),
        "dimW": c.dimW, "|F_W|": len(c.FW), "class_orbits": len(c.reps), "deg_h_g": len(c.kerg_roots)}
print(json.dumps(info))
rng = random.Random(subseed("G4-RS3-m2-17-0"))
rels = []
for _ in range(16):
    legs = [rng.choice(c.FW) for _ in range(2)]
    rels.append(("RS-3 m=2", legs, c.E.sumpts(legs)))
nonG = sum(1 for _, _, R in rels if R is not None and c.E.mul(c.r, R) is not None)
print("G4 relations:", len(rels), " targets R outside G (r*R != O):", nonG)
out = {}
for cb in ("literal", "piG"):
    rd = Readings(cb=cb)
    for name in ("CONTROL", "M1", "M2"):
        I = INSTR[name]; tally = {}
        for src, legs, R in rels:
            res = route_relation(c, src, legs, R, I, rd)
            fr = res["first_rule"]
            fr = fr.split(", j=")[0] if "j=" in fr else fr
            tally[fr] = tally.get(fr, 0) + 1
        out["%s | CERT-BIND reading=%s" % (name, cb)] = tally
        print(name, cb, tally)
for cb in ("literal", "piG"):
    ctl = out["CONTROL | CERT-BIND reading=%s" % cb]; m1 = out["M1 | CERT-BIND reading=%s" % cb]; m2 = out["M2 | CERT-BIND reading=%s" % cb]
    inval = lambda t: any(k.startswith("IR") for k in t)
    g4 = inval(m1) and inval(m2) and not inval(ctl)
    print("G4 verdict under CERT-BIND reading", cb, ":", "PASS" if g4 else "FAIL (IR-18, SR-3b: no rank of the run readable)")
print("elapsed_s", round(time.time() - t0, 1))

# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea C-PTM-F and C-J3-M3-REFUTE.
# PTM-F: planted rank-consistent FALSE quotient rows (F-i: one orbit's f_O(lambda) + 1; F-ii: one orbit's
# coefficient replaced by f_O(lambda^-1)), with the unmutated valid row as true-positive control, fed to
# CERT-QUOT under three readings: QL = literal formula recomputed from the legs' labels; QR = from the
# relation's raw row as ranked; QQ = from the ranked quotient row itself. Quotient rank read with RANK-A/B.
# M3-REFUTE: at (17,0) search F_W for m = 3 legs in one class orbit with f_O(lambda^-1) = 0 != f_O(lambda);
# route through M3 under R-piG to see whether P2-6 reaches O-REFUTE-Q.
import json, random, sys, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/rt2333ea")
from lib import *
from cell import Cell
from instr import *

def certq_from_coords(c, coords, R):
    S = None
    for o, v in coords.items(): S = c.E.add(S, c.smul(v % c.r, c.reps[o]))
    return S == c.E.mul(c.proj, R)

out = {}
for (n, a) in ((17, 1), (23, 0)):
    c = Cell(n, a); c.kerg_roots = kerg_roots(c); r = c.r; lam = c.lam; li = pow(lam, -1, r)
    rng = random.Random(subseed("PTMF-%d-%d" % (n, a)))
    done = 0; res = []
    while done < 4:
        legs = [rng.choice(c.FW) for _ in range(2)]; R = c.E.sumpts(legs)
        if R is None or c.E.mul(c.proj, R) is None: continue
        polys = c.orbit_polys(legs)
        # need an orbit whose f_O(lambda^-1) != f_O(lambda) for F-ii
        cand = [o for o, f in polys.items() if peval(f, li, r) != peval(f, lam, r)]
        if not cand: continue
        o = cand[0]; done += 1
        true_q = {oo: peval(f, lam, r) for oo, f in polys.items()}
        Fi = dict(true_q); Fi[o] = (Fi[o] + 1) % r
        Fii = dict(true_q); Fii[o] = peval(polys[o], li, r)
        entry = {"legs_orbits": sorted(polys), "planted_orbit": o}
        for name, q in (("valid_control", true_q), ("F-i", Fi), ("F-ii", Fii)):
            rows = [[pow(lam, j, r) * q[oo] % r for oo in sorted(q)] for j in range(c.k)]
            QL = cert_quot(c, legs, R, INSTR["CONTROL"], Readings("piG", "literal"))  # recomputed from legs
            QR = QL  # raw row as ranked is unchanged by a quotient-row plant, so the raw-row reading equals QL
            QQ = certq_from_coords(c, q, R)
            entry[name] = {"quotient_rank_A": rank_A(rows, r), "quotient_rank_B": rank_B(rows, r),
                           "CERT-QUOT QL (literal, from legs)": QL, "CERT-QUOT QR (from ranked raw row)": QR,
                           "CERT-QUOT QQ (from ranked quotient row)": QQ,
                           "on_curve_identity_sum[q_O]Q_O==piG(R)": QQ}
        res.append(entry)
    out["PTM-F (%d,%d)" % (n, a)] = res
print(json.dumps(out, indent=0))

# ---- M3-REFUTE search at (17,0) ----
c = Cell(17, 0); c.kerg_roots = kerg_roots(c); r = c.r; lam = c.lam; li = pow(lam, -1, r)
labs = {}
for P in c.FW:
    o, e, eps = c.label(P); labs.setdefault(o, {}).setdefault((e, eps), []).append(P)
found = []
for o, L in labs.items():
    keys = sorted(L)
    for trip in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(keys, 3):
        f = [0] * c.k
        for e, eps in trip: f[e] = (f[e] + eps) % r
        if not any(f): continue
        if peval(f, li, r) == 0 and peval(f, lam, r) != 0:
            found.append((o, trip))
print("M3 vanishing label-triples at (17,0) (f_O(lambda^-1)=0 != f_O(lambda)):", len(found))
m3 = {"label_triples": len(found), "routed": {}, "examples": []}
seen_G = 0
for o, trip in found:
    for legs in itertools.product(*[labs[o][t] for t in trip]):
        legs = list(legs); R = c.E.sumpts(legs)
        inG = R is not None and c.E.mul(c.r, R) is None
        for rdn, rd in (("R-piG", Readings("piG", "literal")), ("R-piG-ranked", Readings("piG", "ranked")), ("R-lit", Readings("literal", "literal"))):
            res = route_relation(c, "RS-3 m=3 (planted legs)", legs, R, INSTR["M3"], rd)
            key = rdn + " | target_in_G=%s | %s" % (inG, res["first_rule"].split(", j=")[0])
            m3["routed"][key] = m3["routed"].get(key, 0) + 1
            if len(m3["examples"]) < 3 and "O-REFUTE" in res["first_rule"]:
                m3["examples"].append({"orbit": o, "labels(e,eps)": trip, "target_in_G": inG, "reading": rdn,
                                       "ranks(A,B,EVAL)": res["ranks"],
                                       "control_route": route_relation(c, "x", legs, R, INSTR["CONTROL"], rd)["first_rule"]})
print(json.dumps(m3, indent=0, default=str))

# RT C-J3-M3-RS2: distinct G-targets among the M3 vanishing leg-triples at (17,0) whose sum lies in G,
# and the chance that RS-2's 64 seeded targets (of the r - 1 = 238 possible) include at least one.
import sys, itertools
from math import comb
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/rt2333ea")
from lib import *
from cell import Cell
from instr import kerg_roots
c = Cell(17, 0); r = c.r; lam = c.lam; li = pow(lam, -1, r)
labs = {}
for P in c.FW:
    o, e, eps = c.label(P); labs.setdefault(o, {}).setdefault((e, eps), []).append(P)
T = set(); ntrip = 0
for o, L in labs.items():
    for trip in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(sorted(L), 3):
        f = [0] * c.k
        for e, eps in trip: f[e] = (f[e] + eps) % r
        if any(f) and peval(f, li, r) == 0 and peval(f, lam, r) != 0:
            for legs in itertools.product(*[L[t] for t in trip]):
                R = c.E.sumpts(list(legs))
                if R is not None and c.E.mul(r, R) is None: T.add(R); ntrip += 1
print("in-G vanishing leg-triples:", ntrip, " distinct targets:", len(T))
p_none = comb(r - 1 - len(T), 64) / comb(r - 1, 64)

# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea C-J4-RC4 (2026-10-06 continuation). J4 (i) RC-4 = PTM-A null object.
# v2's rules run in this reviewer's own script on E_b: y^2 + xy = x^3 + x^2 + b, b in F_{2^n} \ F_2,
# at the positive-arm n = 17 with the first stable W = ker f1(tau) (spec controls CTL-NULL and its
# v2_reading; definitions k_and_q, AR-2_v2, ker_g_null_expectation; IR-5, IR-7, IR-19; L6).
# Review computation, toy size, stdlib only. No RUN-*, no solver, no EXP-BINSTD-178742 driver.
import sys, random, time, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/rt3/j3")
from lib import *
from cell import phi_factors, kernel_of_g

t0 = time.time()
n = 17
F = GF(n)
N = (1 << n) - 1
print("field modulus (lowest weight, then least integer):", bin(F.M))
assert is_prime(N)  # 2^17 - 1 prime, so X generates F*
EXP = [0] * N; x = 1
for i in range(N):
    EXP[i] = x; x <<= 1
    if x >> n: x ^= F.M
assert x == 1
LOG = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(EXP)}
tmask = 0
for j in range(n):
    if F.trace(1 << j) & 1: tmask |= 1 << j
TR = [bin(v & tmask).count("1") & 1 for v in EXP]

def count_points(a2, a6):
    """Named routine: exhaustive x-enumeration with the additive trace criterion. For x != 0,
    y = x z gives z^2 + z = x + a2 + a6 / x^2, solvable (two points) iff Tr = 0; x = 0 gives the
    single point (0, sqrt(a6)); plus O. Tr(a6/x^2) = Tr(sqrt(a6)/x) is read from the tables."""
    ta2 = TR[LOG[a2]] if a2 else 0
    Ls = LOG[F.sqrt(a6)]
    c = 0
    for i in range(N):
        if TR[i] ^ ta2 ^ TR[(Ls - i) % N] == 0: c += 1
    return 2 + 2 * c

# routine self-check on the two Koblitz curves at n = 17 against the Lucas recurrence
for a in (0, 1):
    cnt = count_points(a, 1); luc = lucas_order(n, 1 if a == 1 else -1)
    print("routine check E_%d(F_2^17): count %d, Lucas %d, equal %s" % (a, cnt, luc, cnt == luc))
    assert cnt == luc

# ---- seeded draw of b with the v2 redraw rule (E1-a and E1-c of P2-E1 applied to E_b) ----
rng = random.Random(subseed("RC4|PTM-A|n=17|b"))
draws = []
while True:
    b = rng.randrange(2, 1 << n)
    order = count_points(1, b); fac = factorint(order); r = max(fac)
    e1a = order % (r * r) != 0; e1c = (r - 1) // 2 >= 4 * n
    draws.append({"b": b, "order": order, "factorisation": fac, "r": r, "E1-a": e1a, "E1-c": e1c})
    if e1a and e1c: break
print("draws:", json.dumps([{**d, "factorisation": {str(k): v for k, v in d["factorisation"].items()}} for d in draws]))
print("redraw count (draws rejected before acceptance):", len(draws) - 1)
h = order // r
E = Curve(F, 1, b)
proj = h * pow(h, -1, r)

# ---- d_min, q, k from the coefficients (definitions.k_and_q) ----
coeffs = [1, 1, b]  # a1 = 1, a2 = 1, a6 = b
divs = [d for d in range(1, n + 1) if n % d == 0]
dmin = next(d for d in divs if all(F.frob(c, d) == c for c in coeffs))
q = 1 << dmin; k = n // dmin
print("divisors of m:", divs, "d_min:", dmin, "q = 2^%d" % dmin, "k:", k)

# ---- generator P0 of G, lambda, AR-2 (both stated forms) ----
prng = random.Random(subseed("RC4|PTM-A|n=17|P0"))
while True:
    xx = prng.randrange(2, 1 << n); pts = E.points_at_x(xx)
    if pts:
        P0 = E.mul(h, pts[0])
        if P0 is not None: break
assert E.mul(r, P0) is None
t = q + 1 - order
disc = (t * t - 4 * q) % r
s = sqrt_mod(disc, r)
i2 = pow(2, -1, r)
cands = sorted({(t + s) * i2 % r, (t - s) * i2 % r})
tauq = lambda P: E.frob(P, dmin)  # q-power Frobenius; identity on E(F_{2^17}) because d_min = n
lam = [c for c in cands if E.mul(c, P0) == tauq(P0)]
print("trace t:", t, "candidate roots mod r of X^2 - tX + q:", cands, "kept by [lambda]P0 = tau_q(P0):", lam)
assert lam == [1]; lam = 1

def prime_divisors(m):
    return [p for p in range(2, m + 1) if m % p == 0 and all(p % d for d in range(2, p))]
def AR2_v2(lam, k, r, delete_order_clause=False):
    if pow(lam, k, r) != 1: return ("reject", "lambda^k != 1")
    if not delete_order_clause:
        for p in prime_divisors(k):
            if pow(lam, k // p, r) == 1:
                o = next(e for e in range(1, k + 1) if pow(lam, e, r) == 1)
                return ("reject", "ord(lambda) = %d != %d (clause lambda^(k/%d) != 1)" % (o, k, p))
    return ("admit", "lambda^k = 1; order clause over primes of k = %s" % prime_divisors(k))
def AR2_definitions_lambda(lam, k, r):  # the carried v1 sentence in definitions.lambda
    if pow(lam, k, r) != 1: return ("reject", "lambda^k != 1")
    if lam == 1: return ("reject", "lambda = 1")
    return ("admit", "lambda^k = 1 and lambda != 1")
print("AR-2_v2 at k = 1:", AR2_v2(lam, k, r))
print("definitions.lambda form at k = 1:", AR2_definitions_lambda(lam, k, r))
# The same seeded b-sequence, with each draw's lambda computed in full, under both stated forms of AR-2
# used as E1-d (the v2_reading says E1-d changes no redraw; that holds for AR-2_v2 only).
r2 = random.Random(subseed("RC4|PTM-A|n=17|b"))
seq = []
for _ in range(10):
    bb = r2.randrange(2, 1 << n); Eq = Curve(F, 1, bb)
    oo = count_points(1, bb); rr = max(factorint(oo)); hh = oo // rr
    pr = random.Random(subseed("RC4|PTM-A|n=17|seq|%d" % bb))
    while True:
        xq = pr.randrange(2, 1 << n); pq = Eq.points_at_x(xq)
        if pq:
            Pq = Eq.mul(hh, pq[0])
            if Pq is not None: break
    tt = (1 << n) + 1 - oo; ss = sqrt_mod((tt * tt - 4 * (1 << n)) % rr, rr)
    cc = sorted({(tt + ss) * pow(2, -1, rr) % rr, (tt - ss) * pow(2, -1, rr) % rr})
    ll = [c for c in cc if Eq.mul(c, Pq) == Eq.frob(Pq, n)]
    seq.append((bb, rr, ll, AR2_v2(ll[0], 1, rr)[0], AR2_definitions_lambda(ll[0], 1, rr)[0]))
print("first 10 draws (b, r, kept lambda, AR-2_v2, definitions.lambda form):", seq)

# ---- first stable W at n = 17 and the factor base F_W on E_b ----
facs, dd = phi_factors(n)
f1 = facs[0]
W, dimW = kernel_of_g(F, f1)
print("f1 =", bin(f1), "dim W =", dimW, "1 in W:", 1 in W)
FW = []
for xw in W:
    if xw in (0, 1): continue
    for P in E.points_at_x(xw):
        if E.mul(proj, P) is not None: FW.append(P)
FWset = set(FW)
piG = {P: E.mul(proj, P) for P in FW}
print("|F_W| =", len(FW))

# ---- L6: tau = 2-power Frobenius on every factor-base point ----
Eb2 = Curve(F, 1, F.sq(b))
on_Eb = sum(1 for P in FW if E.on(E.frob(P, 1)))
on_Eb2 = sum(1 for P in FW if Eb2.on(E.frob(P, 1)))
print("L6: tau(P) on E_b for", on_Eb, "of", len(FW), "F_W points; on E_{b^2} for", on_Eb2)

# ---- classes, orbits under tau_q, histograms ----
classes = {}
for P in FW:
    Q = piG[P]; classes.setdefault(Q[0], set()).update({Q, E.neg(Q)})
reps = {xq: min(S, key=lambda p: p[1]) for xq, S in classes.items()}  # m-J1-4: lesser y
cls_orbit_len = {}
for xq in reps:
    o, Q = 1, tauq(reps[xq])
    while Q[0] != xq: Q = tauq(Q); o += 1
    cls_orbit_len[xq] = o
pt_orbit_len = {}
for P in FW:
    o, Q = 1, tauq(P)
    while Q != P: Q = tauq(Q); o += 1
    pt_orbit_len[P] = o
print("|V| (G-classes up to sign):", len(reps), "class-orbit lengths:", sorted(set(cls_orbit_len.values())),
      "point-orbit lengths:", sorted(set(pt_orbit_len.values())))
print("IR-7 literal ('point orbit of length other than n'):",
      "FIRES" if any(v != n for v in pt_orbit_len.values()) else "silent",
      "| IR-7 read by L2 (length k):", "FIRES" if any(v != k for v in pt_orbit_len.values()) else "silent")

def label(P):
    Q = piG[P]; QO = reps[Q[0]]
    return (Q[0], 0, 1 if Q == QO else -1)

# ---- relations: RS-1 (32 targets, m = 2) and RS-3 (64 planted, m = 2) ----
rels = []
trng = random.Random(subseed("RC4|PTM-A|n=17|RS-1"))
for _ in range(32):
    sR = trng.randrange(1, r); R = E.mul(sR, P0); seen = set()
    for P1 in FW:
        P2 = E.add(R, E.neg(P1))
        if P2 in FWset:
            key = tuple(sorted([P1, P2]))
            if key not in seen: seen.add(key); rels.append(("RS-1", list(key), R))
rs1 = len(rels)
prng3 = random.Random(subseed("RC4|PTM-A|n=17|RS-3"))
for _ in range(64):
    legs = [prng3.choice(FW), prng3.choice(FW)]
    rels.append(("RS-3", legs, E.sumpts(legs)))
print("relations generated: RS-1", rs1, "RS-3", len(rels) - rs1)

stats = {"admitted": 0, "AR1_reject": 0, "IR-16": 0, "IR-15": 0, "CERT-BIND_checks": 0, "conjugate_rows": 0,
         "rank_ok": 0, "rank_bad": 0, "raw_ne_quot": 0, "kerg_computed_under_v2": 0,
         "mutant_kerg_rank0": 0, "mutant_basis_difference": 0}
examples = []
ghat1 = {name: bin(g).count("1") % r for name, g in
         (("f1", f1), ("f2", facs[1]), ("(X+1) f1", pmul(3, f1)), ("(X+1) f2", pmul(3, facs[1])))}
deg_hg_mutant = {name: 1 if v == 0 else 0 for name, v in ghat1.items()}
for src, legs, R in rels:
    # AR-1
    if not (all(P in FWset for P in legs) and E.on(R) and E.sumpts(legs) == R and E.mul(proj, R) is not None):
        stats["AR1_reject"] += 1; continue
    stats["admitted"] += 1
    labs = [label(P) for P in legs]
    # P2-2b at k = 1: CERT-LABEL per leg, CERT-QUOT, CERT-BIND over rows 1..k-1 (none)
    for P, (xo, e, eps) in zip(legs, labs):
        QO = reps[xo]
        if E.mul(proj, P) != (QO if eps == 1 else E.neg(QO)): stats["IR-16"] += 1
    fO = {}
    for (xo, e, eps) in labs: fO[xo] = (fO.get(xo, 0) + eps) % r
    lhs = E.sumpts([E.mul(c, reps[xo]) for xo, c in fO.items() if c])
    if lhs != E.mul(proj, R): stats["IR-15"] += 1
    stats["CERT-BIND_checks"] += k - 1; stats["conjugate_rows"] += k - 1
    # ranks: one row per relation in every basis (k = 1 forms no conjugate row)
    ocols = sorted(fO); raw_class = [[fO[o] for o in ocols]]
    pcols = sorted(set(legs)); raw_point = [[legs.count(P) for P in pcols]]
    quot = [[peval([fO[o]], lam, r) for o in ocols]]
    rk = {"raw_class": (rank_A(raw_class, r), rank_B(raw_class, r)),
          "raw_point": (rank_A(raw_point, r), rank_B(raw_point, r)),
          "quotient": (rank_A(quot, r), rank_B(quot, r))}
    ev = 1 if any(fO[o] for o in ocols) else 0
    ok = all(a == b == ev == 1 for a, b in rk.values())
    stats["rank_ok" if ok else "rank_bad"] += 1
    if rk["raw_class"][0] != rk["quotient"][0]: stats["raw_ne_quot"] += 1
    # ker-g: NOT COMPUTED under v2 (ker_g_null_expectation; IR-5, IR-19). Mutant with the rule deleted:
    # h_g = gcd(g-hat mod r, X - 1) has degree 1 iff g-hat(1) = 0 mod r; with degree 0 the space is zero.
    rk_kerg_mut = 0 if deg_hg_mutant["f1"] == 0 else (1 if any(fO[o] for o in ocols) else 0)
    if rk_kerg_mut == 0: stats["mutant_kerg_rank0"] += 1
    if rk_kerg_mut != rk["raw_class"][0]: stats["mutant_basis_difference"] += 1

# under BOTH readings of "tau": (R-q) the q-power Frobenius with q = 2^d_min (L1, L2, definitions.k_and_q),
# and (R-2) the 2-power Frobenius (x, y) -> (x^2, y^2) of L6, whose orbit leaves E_b and returns after
# n steps on the tower E_b -> E_{b^2} -> ... -> E_{b^(2^n)} = E_b. Same seeded E_b, W and F_W as rc4.py.
# Review computation, toy size, stdlib only. No RUN-*, no solver, no EXP-BINSTD-178742 driver.
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/rt3/j3")
from lib import *
from cell import phi_factors, kernel_of_g

t0 = time.time()
n = 17
F = GF(n)
N = (1 << n) - 1
EXP = [0] * N; x = 1
for i in range(N):
    EXP[i] = x; x <<= 1
    if x >> n: x ^= F.M
LOG = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(EXP)}
tmask = 0
for j in range(n):
    if F.trace(1 << j) & 1: tmask |= 1 << j
TR = [bin(v & tmask).count("1") & 1 for v in EXP]
def count_points(a2, a6):
    ta2 = TR[LOG[a2]] if a2 else 0
    Ls = LOG[F.sqrt(a6)]
    return 2 + 2 * sum(1 for i in range(N) if TR[i] ^ ta2 ^ TR[(Ls - i) % N] == 0)

rng = random.Random(subseed("RC4|PTM-A|n=17|b"))
while True:
    b = rng.randrange(2, 1 << n)
    order = count_points(1, b); fac = factorint(order); r = max(fac)
    if order % (r * r) != 0 and (r - 1) // 2 >= 4 * n: break
h = order // r; proj = h * pow(h, -1, r)
E = Curve(F, 1, b)
coeffs = [1, 1, b]
dmin = next(d for d in range(1, n + 1) if n % d == 0 and all(F.frob(c, d) == c for c in coeffs))
k = n // dmin
print("E_b: b =", b, "#E =", order, "r =", r, "d_min =", dmin, "k =", k)

facs, _ = phi_factors(n)
W, dimW = kernel_of_g(F, facs[0])
FW = [P for xw in W if xw not in (0, 1) for P in E.points_at_x(xw) if E.mul(proj, P) is not None]
classes = {}
for P in FW:
    Q = E.mul(proj, P); classes.setdefault(Q[0], set()).update({Q, E.neg(Q)})
reps = {xq: min(S, key=lambda p: p[1]) for xq, S in classes.items()}
print("|F_W| =", len(FW), "|V| =", len(reps))

def frob_pt(P, j): return (F.frob(P[0], j), F.frob(P[1], j))
def curve_b_of(j): return F.frob(b, j)  # tau^j maps E_b onto E_{b^(2^j)}

# (R-q): tau = q-power Frobenius, q = 2^d_min = 2^n: identity on E_b(F_{2^n})
def orbit_len_q(P):
    o, Q = 1, frob_pt(P, dmin)
    while Q != P: Q = frob_pt(Q, dmin); o += 1
    return o
# (R-2): tau = 2-power Frobenius; least j >= 1 with tau^j(P) = P, and the curves visited
def orbit_len_2(P):
    j, Q = 1, frob_pt(P, 1)
    while Q != P: Q = frob_pt(Q, 1); j += 1
    return j
pq = sorted({orbit_len_q(P) for P in FW}); cq = sorted({orbit_len_q(Q) for Q in reps.values()})
p2 = sorted({orbit_len_2(P) for P in FW}); c2 = sorted({orbit_len_2(Q) for Q in reps.values()})
visits_Eb = sum(1 for P in FW for i in range(1, n) if Curve(F, 1, b).on(frob_pt(P, i)))
on_conj = all(Curve(F, 1, curve_b_of(i)).on(frob_pt(P, i)) for P in FW for i in range(n))
print("(R-q) point-orbit lengths:", pq, "class-orbit lengths:", cq)
print("(R-2) point-orbit lengths on the tower:", p2, "class-orbit lengths on the tower:", c2,
      "| intermediate images on E_b itself:", visits_Eb, "| every tau^i(P) on E_{b^(2^i)}:", on_conj)
def ir7(point_lens, class_lens, point_target):
    fires = []
    if any(l != k for l in class_lens): fires.append("class clause (length != k)")
    if any(l != point_target for l in point_lens): fires.append("point clause (length != %s)" % ("n" if point_target == n else "k"))
    return fires or ["silent"]

print("IR-7 with n read as k (L2):                R-q ->", ir7(pq, cq, k), "| R-2 ->", ir7(p2, c2, k))
print("elapsed_s %.1f" % (time.time() - t0))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea C-J4 re-execution 2 (2026-10-06 continuation, J4 write-up step).
# Runs every J4 review script once under /usr/local/bin/python3 and records exit status and UTC times.
# Review computations only: no RUN-*, no solver, no EXP-BINSTD-178742 driver.
set -u
OUT=/tmp/rt3/j4/final/out
mkdir -p "$OUT"
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$OUT/start.txt"
/usr/local/bin/python3 --version > "$OUT/python_version.txt" 2>&1
for s in rc4 rc4b rc5; do
  ( cd /tmp/rt3/j4 && /usr/local/bin/python3 "$s.py" > "$OUT/$s.out" 2> "$OUT/$s.err" )
  echo "$s exit=$? $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$OUT/status.txt"
done
( cd /workspace && /usr/local/bin/python3 /tmp/rt3/j4/sweep.py > "$OUT/sweep.out" 2> "$OUT/sweep.err" )
echo "sweep exit=$? $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$OUT/status.txt"
( cd /workspace && /usr/local/bin/python3 /tmp/rt3/j4/rerun/sweep_loose_reconstructed.py > "$OUT/sweep_loose.out" 2> "$OUT/sweep_loose.err" )
echo "sweep_loose exit=$? $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$OUT/status.txt"
cp /tmp/rt3/j4/enum.json "$OUT/enum.before.json"
( cd /workspace && /usr/local/bin/python3 /tmp/rt3/j4/scope_enum.py > "$OUT/scope_enum.out" 2> "$OUT/scope_enum.err" )
echo "scope_enum exit=$? $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$OUT/status.txt"
cp /tmp/rt3/j4/enum.json "$OUT/enum.after.json"
if cmp -s "$OUT/enum.before.json" "$OUT/enum.after.json"; then echo "enum.json rewritten byte-identical: yes" >> "$OUT/status.txt"; else echo "enum.json rewritten byte-identical: NO" >> "$OUT/status.txt"; fi
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$OUT/end.txt"

# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea PTM-B: size-matched NON-stable F_2-subspace factor base W' (CTL-NONSTABLE, L7, IR-6).
# Review computation at toy size; no RUN-*, no EXP-BINSTD-178742 driver.
import sys, time, json, random
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rt3/j3')
from lib import *
from cell import Cell
from instr import INSTR, Readings, cert_label, cert_quot, cert_bind, ranks, kerg_roots, route_relation

t0 = time.time()
n = 17
I = INSTR["CONTROL"]
for a in (0, 1):
    c = Cell(n, a)
    c.kerg_roots = kerg_roots(c)
    F, E, r, k = c.F, c.E, c.r, c.k
    l = c.dimW
    W_stable = set(c.W); FW_stable_size = len(c.FW)
    print("== (n, a) = (%d, %d): r = %d, h = %d, lambda = %d, k = %d; first stable W = ker f1(tau), dim %d, |F_W| = %d"
          % (n, a, r, c.h, c.lam, k, l, FW_stable_size))
    rng = random.Random(subseed("PTM-B|n=%d|a=%d|Wprime" % (n, a)))
    redraw_dependent = 0; redraw_core = 0
    while True:
        gens = [rng.randrange(1, 1 << n) for _ in range(l)]
        span = {0}; dep = False
        for g in gens:
            if g in span: dep = True; break
            span |= {s ^ g for s in span}
        if dep: redraw_dependent += 1; continue
        core = {x for x in span if all(F.frob(x, j) in span for j in range(n))}
        dimC = len(core).bit_length() - 1
        if dimC <= 1: break
        redraw_core += 1
    print("W' generators (seeded):", gens)
    print("redraws: linearly dependent %d, dim C(W') > 1 %d; accepted dim W' = %d, C(W') = %s, dim C(W') = %d"
          % (redraw_dependent, redraw_core, len(span).bit_length() - 1, sorted(core), dimC))
    print("W' tau-stable:", all(F.sq(x) in span for x in span), "| W' == stable W:", span == W_stable, "| 1 in W':", 1 in span)
    c.W = sorted(span); c.build_base()
    FW, FWset = c.FW, c.FWset
    classes = {c.piGmap[P][0] for P in FW}
    orbit_closed = sum(1 for x in classes if all(F.frob(x, e) in classes for e in range(n)))
    print("|F_W'| = %d, |V'| (G-classes up to sign) = %d of (r - 1)/2 = %d; classes whose whole tau-orbit lies in V': %d"
          % (len(FW), len(classes), (r - 1) // 2, orbit_closed))
    rels = []
    rt = random.Random(subseed("PTM-B|n=%d|a=%d|RS-1" % (n, a)))
    for _ in range(32):
        R = E.mul(rt.randrange(1, r), c.P0); seen = set()
        for P1 in FW:
            P2 = E.add(R, E.neg(P1))
            if P2 in FWset:
                pk = tuple(sorted([P1, P2]))
                if pk not in seen: seen.add(pk); rels.append(("RS-1", list(pk), R))
    r3 = random.Random(subseed("PTM-B|n=%d|a=%d|RS-3" % (n, a)))
    for _ in range(64):
        legs = [r3.choice(FW) for _ in range(2)]
        rels.append(("RS-3", legs, E.sumpts(legs)))
    st = Counter(); firstj = Counter(); mut_raw = Counter(); mut_q = Counter(); route = Counter()
    for src, legs, R in rels:
        if not (all(P in FWset for P in legs) and E.sumpts(legs) == R and c.piG(R) is not None):
            st["AR1_reject_" + src] += 1; continue
        st["admitted_" + src] += 1
        rows = [[E.frob(P, j) for P in legs] for j in range(k)]
        inside = [all(Q in FWset for Q in rows[j]) for j in range(k)]
        st["rows_j>=1_wholly_in_F_W'"] += sum(inside[1:])
        if not all(inside[1:]): st["family_leaves_base"] += 1
        else: st["family_stays_in_base"] += 1
        for P in legs:
            firstj[next(j for j in range(1, k) if E.frob(P, j) not in FWset)] += 1
        for name, rd in (("R-lit", Readings("literal")), ("R-piG", Readings("piG"))):
            okl = all(cert_label(c, Q, I, rd) for row in rows for Q in row)
            okq = cert_quot(c, legs, R, I, rd)
            fb = cert_bind(c, rows, R, I, rd)
            st["%s: CERT-LABEL every leg of every row passes" % name] += okl
            st["%s: CERT-QUOT row 0 passes" % name] += okq
            st["%s: CERT-BIND rows 1..k-1 pass" % name] += (fb is None)
        rt_ = route_relation(c, src, legs, R, I, Readings("piG"))
        route[rt_["first_rule"]] += 1
        rk = ranks(c, rows, I)
        mut_raw["raw_class rank %d (EVAL %d)" % (rk["raw_class"][0], rk["raw_class"][2])] += 1
        mut_q["quotient rank %d" % rk["quotient"][0]] += 1
    print("relations generated: RS-1 %d, RS-3 %d" % (sum(1 for x in rels if x[0] == "RS-1"), sum(1 for x in rels if x[0] == "RS-3")))
    print("stats:", json.dumps(dict(sorted(st.items()))))
    print("first j >= 1 at which a leg leaves F_W' (histogram over legs):", dict(sorted(firstj.items())))
    print("CTL-NONSTABLE as written (membership test on every tau^j(leg)): families admitted as relations over W' = %d; ranks reported for them: none"
          % st["family_stays_in_base"])
    print("v2 stable pipeline with the membership test deleted (route_relation, CERT-BIND on pi_G(R)):", dict(route))
    print("  its family ranks:", dict(mut_raw), dict(mut_q))
print("elapsed_s %.1f" % (time.time() - t0))

# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea PTM-C: forced-negative degrees n in {19, 29, 37} through the readout
# (CTL-FORCED-NEGATIVE, cells.forced_negative_arm, IR-3) and through the amended admission rule E1' (P2-E1).
# Review computation at toy size; no RUN-*, no EXP-BINSTD-178742 driver.
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rt3/j3')
from lib import *

t0 = time.time()

def ord_route_a(n):
    # prime-divisor test on n - 1: ord = n - 1 iff 2^((n-1)/p) != 1 mod n for every prime p | n - 1
    return (n - 1) if all(pow(2, (n - 1) // p, n) != 1 for p in prime_factors(n - 1)) else None
def ord_route_b(n):
    k, x = 1, 2 % n
    while x != 1: x = x * 2 % n; k += 1
    return k

def ddf_irreducible(f):
    # independent of lib.irreducible: no irreducible factor of degree d <= deg f / 2 (gcd with X^(2^d) - X)
    n = pdeg(f); x = 2
    for d in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        x = pmod(pmul(x, x), f)
        if pgcd(f, x ^ 2) != 1: return False, d
    return True, None

def dim_ker(F, g):
    # F_2-rank of L_g(x) = sum_i g_i x^(2^i) on the polynomial basis; dim ker = n - rank
    n = F.n
    def L(x):
        s = 0; t = x
        for i in range(pdeg(g) + 1):
            if (g >> i) & 1: s ^= t
            t = F.sq(t)
        return s
    rows = []
    for i in range(n):
        v = L(1 << i)
        for b in rows:
            if v ^ b < v: v ^= b
        if v: rows.append(v); rows.sort(reverse=True)
    return n - len(rows)

def ar2_v2(lam, k, r):
    if pow(lam, k, r) != 1: return ("reject", "clause lambda^k = 1 failed")
    for p in prime_factors(k):
        if pow(lam, k // p, r) == 1: return ("reject", "ord(lambda) != k (clause lambda^(k/%d) != 1)" % p)
    return ("admit", "ord(lambda) = k")

for n in (19, 29, 37):
    oa, ob = ord_route_a(n), ord_route_b(n)
    phi = (1 << n) - 1                       # 1 + X + ... + X^(n-1)
    xn1 = (1 << n) | 1                       # X^n + 1 = X^n - 1 over F_2
    assert pmul(3, phi) == xn1
    irr_rabin = irreducible(phi)
    irr_ddf, dfac = ddf_irreducible(phi)
    divisors = [("1", 1), ("X + 1", 3), ("Phi_n", phi), ("X^n - 1", xn1)] if irr_rabin else None
    usable = [nm for nm, g in divisors if 2 <= pdeg(g) <= n - 2]
    F = GF(n)
    dims = {nm: dim_ker(F, g) for nm, g in divisors if nm in ("X + 1", "Phi_n")}
    print("== n = %d: ord_n(2) route (a) = %s, route (b) = %d, equal n - 1: %s" % (n, oa, ob, oa == ob == n - 1))
    print("   X^n - 1 = (X + 1) Phi_n; Phi_n irreducible: Rabin (lib.irreducible) %s, distinct-degree gcd test %s" % (irr_rabin, irr_ddf))
    print("   monic divisors (name, degree):", [(nm, pdeg(g)) for nm, g in divisors])
    print("   usable (2 <= deg g <= n - 2):", usable, "| IR-3 fires:", bool(usable) or oa != n - 1)
    print("   tau-stable subspaces the usability bound excludes: dim ker (X+1)(tau) = %d, dim ker Phi_n(tau) = %d (field modulus %s)"
          % (dims["X + 1"], dims["Phi_n"], bin(F.M)))
    for a in (0, 1):
        t = 1 if a == 1 else -1
        E = Curve(F, a, 1)
        order = lucas_order(n, t)
        fac = factorint(order)
        r = max(fac); h = order // r
        e1a = order % (r * r) != 0
        e1b = (2 if a == 1 else 4) % r != 0
        e1c = (r - 1) // 2 >= 4 * n
        rng = random.Random(subseed("PTM-C|n=%d|a=%d|P" % (n, a)))
        while True:
            x = rng.randrange(2, 1 << n); pts = E.points_at_x(x)
            if pts:
                P0 = E.mul(h, pts[0])
                if P0 is not None: break
        rP0 = E.mul(r, P0) is None
        s = sqrt_mod(t * t - 8, r); i2 = pow(2, -1, r)
        cands = sorted({(t + s) * i2 % r, (t - s) * i2 % r}) if s is not None else []
        tP0 = E.frob(P0)
        kept = [lc for lc in cands if E.mul(lc, P0) == tP0]
        ar2 = ar2_v2(kept[0], n, r) if kept else ("reject", "no root kept")
        adm = e1a and e1b and e1c and ar2[0] == "admit"
        print("   E1' applied at (n, a) = (%d, %d): #E = %d = %s, r = %d, E1-a %s, E1-b %s, E1-c %s ((r-1)/2 = %d >= %d), [r]P0 = O %s, lambda %s, AR-2_v2 %s -> clauses %s"
              % (n, a, order, " x ".join("%d^%d" % (p, e) if e > 1 else str(p) for p, e in sorted(fac.items())), r, e1a, e1b, e1c,
                 (r - 1) // 2, 4 * n, rP0, kept, ar2, "all hold" if adm else "fail"))
    print("   measurable cell at n = %d: none (no usable stable W, so no F_W, no relation, no rank)" % n)
print("elapsed_s %.1f" % (time.time() - t0))

# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea PTM-E: E1' (P2-E1) on two planted cells per positive-arm (n, a):
# (E-i) composite r' = p1 p2 with p1, p2 below the E1' threshold and r' above it;
# (E-ii) a prime above the threshold from the OTHER Koblitz curve at the same n, verified not to divide #E_a.
# Plus one nearby object outside the plan's list: (E-iii) a composite of two primes that both divide #E_a.
# Review computation at toy size; no RUN-*, no EXP-BINSTD-178742 driver.
import sys, time, random
import yaml
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rt3/j3')
from lib import *

t0 = time.time()
SPEC = '/workspace/experiments/EXP-BINSTD-178742/specification.yaml'
table = {(row['n'], row['a']): row for row in yaml.safe_load(open(SPEC))['experiment']['cells']['positive_arm']['e1_admissibility_table']['rows']}

def threshold(n): return 8 * n + 1          # least r with (r - 1)/2 >= 4 n
def tval(a): return 1 if a == 1 else -1
def roots_mod_prime(t, p):
    if p == 2: return [x for x in range(2) if (x * x - t * x + 2) % 2 == 0]
    s = sqrt_mod((t * t - 8) % p, p)
    if s is None: return []
    i2 = pow(2, -1, p)
    return sorted({(t + s) * i2 % p, (t - s) * i2 % p})
def roots_mod(t, m):
    sols = [(0, 1)]
    for p, e in sorted(factorint(m).items()):
        pe = p ** e
        rs = roots_mod_prime(t, p) if e == 1 else [x for x in range(pe) if (x * x - t * x + 2) % pe == 0]
        sols = [((x + M * (((rr - x) * pow(M, -1, pe)) % pe)) % (M * pe), M * pe) for x, M in sols for rr in rs]
    return sorted(y for y, _ in sols)
def ar2_arith(lam, k, r):
    if pow(lam, k, r) != 1: return ("reject", "clause lambda^k = 1 failed (lambda^k = %d)" % pow(lam, k, r))
    for p in prime_factors(k):
        if pow(lam, k // p, r) == 1: return ("reject", "ord(lambda) != k (clause lambda^(k/%d) != 1)" % p)
    return ("admit", "ord(lambda) = k")

DECLARED = [
    # (label, n, a, r', kind)
    ("E-i@(23,0)",   23, 0, 47 * 139, "composite, p1 = 47, p2 = 139, both 1 mod 23, both below the threshold 185"),
    ("E-ii@(23,0)",  23, 0, None,     "largest prime factor of #E_1(F_2^23), planted on a = 0"),
    ("E-i@(17,1)",   17, 1, 3 * 103,  "composite, p1 = 3, p2 = 103, both below the threshold 137"),
    ("E-ii@(17,1)",  17, 1, None,     "largest prime factor of #E_0(F_2^17), planted on a = 1"),
    ("E-iii@(17,0)", 17, 0, 137 * 239, "NEARBY OBJECT, not a PTM-E cell: composite of the two odd primes of #E_0(F_2^17), each dividing it once"),
]
print("DECLARED before evaluation (label, n, a, r', kind):")
cells = []
for lab, n, a, rp, kind in DECLARED:
    if rp is None:
        rp = max(factorint(lucas_order(n, tval(1 - a))))
    cells.append((lab, n, a, rp, kind))
    print("  ", lab, n, a, rp, "|", kind)
print("PRE-EVALUATION VERIFICATION:")
for lab, n, a, rp, kind in cells:
    order = lucas_order(n, tval(a)); fr = factorint(rp)
    print("   %s: #E_%d(F_2^%d) = %d = %s | r' = %d = %s, prime %s | r' | #E_a: %s | threshold %d: r' above %s, every prime factor below %s"
          % (lab, a, n, order, factorint(order), rp, fr, is_prime(rp), order % rp == 0, threshold(n), rp >= threshold(n),
             all(p < threshold(n) for p in fr)))

print("READING R-clause (E1-a to E1-d evaluated on (n, a, r') as handed in, in that order):")
for lab, n, a, rp, kind in cells:
    t = tval(a); F = GF(n); E = Curve(F, a, 1)
    order = lucas_order(n, t)
    e1a = order % (rp * rp) != 0
    e1b = (2 if a == 1 else 4) % rp != 0
    e1c = (rp - 1) // 2 >= 4 * n
    cands = roots_mod(t, rp)
    arith = {lam: ar2_arith(lam, n, rp) for lam in cands}
    rng = random.Random(subseed("PTM-E|%s|P" % lab))
    hfloor = order // rp
    while True:
        x = rng.randrange(2, 1 << n); pts = E.points_at_x(x)
        if pts:
            P0 = E.mul(hfloor, pts[0])
            if P0 is not None: break
    rP0 = E.mul(rp, P0) is None
    tP0 = E.frob(P0)
    kept = [lam for lam in cands if E.mul(lam, P0) == tP0]
    passing = [lam for lam in cands if arith[lam][0] == "admit"]
    e1d = ("admit" if any(arith[l][0] == "admit" for l in kept) else "reject")
    if not cands: reason = "no root of X^2 - tX + 2 mod r'"
    elif not passing: reason = "every root fails the order clause: " + "; ".join("%d -> %s" % (l, arith[l][1]) for l in cands)
    elif not kept: reason = "roots %s pass the order clause but none satisfies [lambda] P0 = tau(P0)" % passing
    else: reason = "kept %s, %s" % (kept, arith[kept[0]][1])
    first = next((nm for nm, ok in (("E1-a", e1a), ("E1-b", e1b), ("E1-c", e1c), ("E1-d", e1d == "admit")) if not ok), None)
    print("   %s: E1-a %s, E1-b %s, E1-c %s ((r'-1)/2 = %d >= %d) | size-and-parity clauses alone: %s"
          % (lab, e1a, e1b, e1c, (rp - 1) // 2, 4 * n, "ADMIT" if (e1a and e1b and e1c) else "reject"))
    print("      E1-d (AR-2_v2): roots mod r' %s; %s -> %s" % (cands, reason, e1d))
    print("      P0 = [#E // r'] P with #E // r' = %d (exact: %s): [r'] P0 = O %s" % (hfloor, order % rp == 0, rP0))
    print("      verdict: %s; first failing clause in order: %s; primality check would reject: %s; r' | #E_a check would reject: %s; [r'] P0 = O check would reject: %s"
          % ("ADMITTED" if first is None else "rejected", first, not is_prime(rp), order % rp != 0, not rP0))

print("READING R-derive (P2-E1 as a procedure on (n, a); SR-5b comparison with the frozen e1_admissibility_table):")
for (n, a) in ((23, 0), (17, 1), (17, 0)):
    for label, tt in (("correct t", tval(a)), ("defect: Lucas t sign flipped", -tval(a))):
        order = lucas_order(n, tt); fac = factorint(order); r = max(fac)
        row = table[(n, a)]
        F = GF(n); E = Curve(F, a, 1)
        h = order // r
        rng = random.Random(subseed("PTM-E|derive|%d|%d|%s|P" % (n, a, label)))
        while True:
            x = rng.randrange(2, 1 << n); pts = E.points_at_x(x)
            if pts:
                P0 = E.mul(h, pts[0])
                if P0 is not None: break
        cands = roots_mod(tt, r)
        kept = [lam for lam in cands if E.mul(lam, P0) == E.frob(P0)]
        sr5b = (order != row['group_order']) or (r != row['r'])
        print("   (%d, %d) %s: #E = %d, r = %d (largest prime factor), prime %s | table: group_order %d, r %d -> SR-5b %s | [r] P0 = O on the real curve %s, lambda kept %s"
              % (n, a, label, order, r, is_prime(r), row['group_order'], row['r'], "FIRES (e1_table_disagree, halt before any rank)" if sr5b else "silent",
                 E.mul(r, P0) is None, kept))
print("elapsed_s %.1f" % (time.time() - t0))
scripts.ptme_supp.py:
# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea PTM-E supplement (declared before evaluation):
# (1) E-i'@(17,1): r' = 11 x 29 = 319, both factors below the threshold 137 and both with roots of X^2 - X + 2,
#     so AR-2 cannot reject it by "no root"; does its ORDER clause reject it?
# (2) Forward direction of the norm argument, exhaustively at toy size: if lambda is a root of X^2 - tX + 2 mod an odd
#     prime p with lambda^n = 1 mod p, then p | #E_a(F_2^n) (phi: Z[tau] -> F_p, tau -> lambda, sends N(1 - tau^n) to
#     (1 - lambda^n)(1 - (t - lambda)^n) = 0). The converse is reported, not assumed.
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rt3/j3')
from lib import *

t0 = time.time()
def tval(a): return 1 if a == 1 else -1
def roots_mod_prime(t, p):
    s = sqrt_mod((t * t - 8) % p, p)
    if s is None: return []
    i2 = pow(2, -1, p)
    return sorted({(t + s) * i2 % p, (t - s) * i2 % p})

n, a, rp = 17, 1, 11 * 29
t = tval(a); order = lucas_order(n, t)
r11, r29 = roots_mod_prime(t, 11), roots_mod_prime(t, 29)
cands = sorted({(x + 11 * (((y - x) * pow(11, -1, 29)) % 29)) % rp for x in r11 for y in r29})
print("DECLARED: E-i'@(17,1) r' = 319 = 11 x 29; roots mod 11 %s, mod 29 %s" % (r11, r29))
print("E1-a %s, E1-b %s, E1-c %s ((r'-1)/2 = %d >= %d)" % (order % (rp * rp) != 0, 2 % rp != 0, (rp - 1) // 2 >= 4 * n, (rp - 1) // 2, 4 * n))
print("E1-d (AR-2_v2) per CRT root lambda mod 319: %s" % {lam: ("admit" if pow(lam, n, rp) == 1 and lam != 1 else "reject: lambda^17 = %d" % pow(lam, n, rp)) for lam in cands})
print("prime %s, r' | #E_1 %s" % (is_prime(rp), order % rp == 0))

print("Norm-argument forward direction over every odd prime p < 20000 (p = 7 included):")
for (n, a) in ((17, 0), (17, 1), (23, 0), (23, 1), (29, 0), (29, 1)):
    t = tval(a); order = lucas_order(n, t)
    fwd_viol = 0; conv_viol = []; root_pass = 0
    for p in range(3, 20000, 2):
        if not is_prime(p): continue
        ok = any(pow(lam, n, p) == 1 for lam in roots_mod_prime(t, p))
        div = order % p == 0
        root_pass += ok
        if ok and not div: fwd_viol += 1
        if div and not ok: conv_viol.append(p)
    print("   (%d, %d): primes with a root of order dividing n: %d; forward violations (root passes, p does not divide #E): %d; p | #E without such a root: %s"
          % (n, a, root_pass, fwd_viol, conv_viol))
print("elapsed_s %.1f" % (time.time() - t0))

# RT TASK-20260925-2333ea, 2026-10-06 continuation: PTM-F, done from scratch.
# Rank-consistent FALSE quotient rows planted directly, not through a mutated instrument:
#   F-i     one hit orbit's coordinate f_O(lambda) changed by +1 mod r
#   F-ii    one hit orbit's coordinate replaced by f_O(lambda^-1), on an orbit where the two differ
#   CONTROL the unmutated row (f_O(lambda))_O of the same relation
# Known truth is checked first: the on-curve quotient identity sum_O q_O Q_O = pi_G(R) holds for
# CONTROL and fails for F-i and F-ii, and the k-row quotient block has rank 1 for all three.
# Then each row is routed through v2's per-relation order (P2-2 AR-1; P2-2b CERT-LABEL row 0,
# CERT-QUOT row 0, CERT-BIND rows 1..k-1; P2-3 ranks against EVAL; P2-6 for candidates)
# under five certificate readings. The legs, labels and curve-side rows are the correct
# instrument's (INSTR CONTROL); only the quotient row handed to the rank readout is planted.
import sys, time, random
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rt3/j3')
from lib import *
from cell import Cell
from instr import INSTR, Readings, build_rows_legs, cert_label, cert_quot, cert_bind, ranks, kerg_roots

T0 = time.time()
I = INSTR["CONTROL"]
# (name, CERT-BIND form, CERT-QUOT input at P2-2b, P2-6 re-run reads the exported quotient row)
READINGS = [
    ("R-lit",        "literal", "recompute", False),
    ("R-lit-ranked", "literal", "row",       False),
    ("R-piG",        "piG",     "recompute", False),
    ("R-piG-ranked", "piG",     "row",       False),
    ("R5",           "piG",     "recompute", True),
]
# (n, a, RS-1 targets, RS-3 m=2 draws, RS-3 m=3 draws)
CELLS = [(17, 1, 96, 24, 24), (17, 0, 64, 24, 24), (23, 0, 32, 24, 24)]
VARIANTS = ("CONTROL", "F-i", "F-ii")

def S(label): return random.Random(subseed("PTM-F|" + label))

def onrow(c, q, orbs):
    T = None
    for o in orbs: T = c.E.add(T, c.smul(q[o] % c.r, c.reps[o]))
    return T

def qblock(c, q, orbs):
    return [[pow(c.lam, j, c.r) * q[o] % c.r for o in orbs] for j in range(c.k)]

def memo(cache, key, fn):
    if key not in cache: cache[key] = fn()
    return cache[key]

def make_relations(c, n, a, T1, N2, N3):
    E = c.E; out = []
    rng = S("%d|%d|rels" % (n, a))
    for _ in range(T1):
        R = E.mul(rng.randrange(1, c.r), c.P0); seen = set()
        for P1 in c.FW:
            P2 = E.add(R, E.neg(P1))
            if P2 in c.FWset:
                pk = tuple(sorted([P1, P2]))
                if pk not in seen: seen.add(pk); out.append(("RS-1", list(pk), R))
    for m, cnt in ((2, N2), (3, N3)):
        for _ in range(cnt):
            legs = [rng.choice(c.FW) for _ in range(m)]
            out.append(("RS-3 m=%d" % m, legs, E.sumpts(legs)))
    return out

def prepare(c, n, a, idx, src, legs0, R):
    E, r = c.E, c.r
    rel = {"idx": idx, "src": src, "legs": legs0, "R": R}
    rel["AR1"] = (R is not None and all(P in c.FWset for P in legs0) and E.sumpts(legs0) == R
                  and c.piG(R) is not None)
    if not rel["AR1"]: return rel
    rel["inG"] = E.mul(r, R) is None
    polys0 = c.orbit_polys(legs0, I["lab"])
    orbs = sorted(polys0); rel["orbs"] = orbs; rel["polys"] = polys0
    laminv = pow(c.lam, -1, r)
    true = {o: peval(polys0[o], c.lam, r) for o in orbs}
    inv = {o: peval(polys0[o], laminv, r) for o in orbs}
    rows = {"CONTROL": dict(true)}
    o1 = S("%d|%d|%d|F-i" % (n, a, idx)).choice(orbs)
    q = dict(true); q[o1] = (q[o1] + 1) % r; rows["F-i"] = q; rel["F-i_orbit"] = o1
    cands = [o for o in orbs if inv[o] != true[o]]
    if cands:
        o2 = S("%d|%d|%d|F-ii" % (n, a, idx)).choice(cands)
        q = dict(true); q[o2] = inv[o2]; rows["F-ii"] = q; rel["F-ii_orbit"] = o2
    rel["qrows"] = rows
    rel["curve_rows"] = build_rows_legs(c, legs0, I["builder"])
    target = c.piG(R)
    rel["truth"] = {}
    for v, qv in rows.items():
        blk = qblock(c, qv, orbs)
        rel["truth"][v] = {"identity": onrow(c, qv, orbs) == target,
                           "rankA": rank_A(blk, r), "rankB": rank_B(blk, r)}
    return rel

def route(c, rel, v, rd, cache):
    name, cb, cq, p26row = rd
    r = c.r; key = rel["idx"]; legs0, R, orbs = rel["legs"], rel["R"], rel["orbs"]
    q = rel["qrows"][v]; target = c.piG(R)
    # P2-2b, in the stated order
    if not memo(cache, (key, "label0"), lambda: all(cert_label(c, P, I, Readings()) for P in legs0)):
        return "IR-16 CERT-LABEL row 0: not ranked"
    if cq == "recompute":
        okq = memo(cache, (key, "quot-recompute"), lambda: cert_quot(c, legs0, R, I, Readings()))
    else:
        okq = onrow(c, q, orbs) == target
    if not okq: return "IR-15 CERT-QUOT row 0: not ranked"
    fb = memo(cache, (key, "bind", cb), lambda: cert_bind(c, rel["curve_rows"], R, I, Readings(cb=cb)))
    if fb: return "IR-17 CERT-BIND (%s): not ranked" % fb[0]
    # P2-3: raw class, raw point and ker-g from the curve-side rows; quotient from the row handed in
    rk = dict(memo(cache, (key, "ranks"), lambda: ranks(c, rel["curve_rows"], I)))
    blk = qblock(c, q, orbs)
    qa = rank_A(blk, r); evq = rk["quotient"][2]
    qb = rank_B(blk, r) if qa != evq else qa
    rk["quotient"] = (qa, qb, evq)
    cand = [b for b, (x, y, ev) in rk.items() if x != ev]
    if any(rk[b][0] != rk[b][1] for b in cand): return "IR-14 RANK-A != RANK-B"
    if cand:
        # P2-6 v2_addendum: certificates re-run on the exported rows
        if p26row or cq == "row": ok = onrow(c, q, orbs) == target
        else: ok = memo(cache, (key, "quot-recompute"), lambda: cert_quot(c, legs0, R, I, Readings()))
        ok = ok and memo(cache, (key, "bind", cb), lambda: None) is None
        if not ok: return "P2-6 re-run certificate fails: instrument defect"
        return "P2-6 candidate routed to " + ("O-REFUTE-Q" if "quotient" in cand else "O-REFUTE-L3")
    return "RANKED (= EVAL in every basis: raw class %d, quotient %d)" % (rk["raw_class"][0], qa)

print("PTM-F from scratch. Readings (name, CERT-BIND form, CERT-QUOT input at P2-2b, P2-6 re-run on exported quotient row):")
for rd in READINGS: print("  ", rd)
grand = {rd[0]: Counter() for rd in READINGS}
for (n, a, T1, N2, N3) in CELLS:
    t1 = time.time()
    c = Cell(n, a); c.kerg_roots = kerg_roots(c)
    print("CELL (%d, %d): r = %d, h = %d, k = %d, lambda = %d, AR-2 %s, g = %s, dim W = %d, |F_W| = %d, class orbits %d"
          % (n, a, c.r, c.h, c.k, c.lam, c.AR2, bin(c.g), c.dimW, len(c.FW), len(c.reps)))
    raw = make_relations(c, n, a, T1, N2, N3)
    rels = [prepare(c, n, a, i, s, l, R) for i, (s, l, R) in enumerate(raw)]
    adm = [x for x in rels if x["AR1"]]
    print("   relations drawn %d; AR-1 admitted %d; by (source, target in G): %s"
          % (len(rels), len(adm), dict(sorted(Counter((x["src"], x["inG"]) for x in adm).items()))))
    print("   F-ii formed on %d of %d admitted (not formed when every hit orbit has f_O(lambda^-1) = f_O(lambda))"
          % (sum(1 for x in adm if "F-ii" in x["qrows"]), len(adm)))
    tr = Counter()
    for x in adm:
        for v, t in x["truth"].items():
            tr[(v, "identity", t["identity"])] += 1
            tr[(v, "rank A,B", (t["rankA"], t["rankB"]))] += 1
    print("   KNOWN TRUTH before routing:", dict(sorted(tr.items(), key=str)))
    cache = {}; table = {}
    for rd in READINGS:
        for x in adm:
            for v in VARIANTS:
                if v not in x["qrows"]: continue
                oc = route(c, x, v, rd, cache)
                table.setdefault((rd[0], v, x["inG"]), Counter())[oc] += 1
                grand[rd[0]][(v, oc.split(" (")[0].split(":")[0])] += 1
    for rd in READINGS:
        print("   ROUTING under %s:" % rd[0])
        for v in VARIANTS:
            for g in (True, False):
                if (rd[0], v, g) in table:
                    print("      %-7s target %-9s %s" % (v, "in G" if g else "outside G", dict(table[(rd[0], v, g)])))
    ex = next((x for x in adm if x["src"] == "RS-1" and "F-ii" in x["qrows"]), None)
    if ex is None: ex = next(x for x in adm if "F-ii" in x["qrows"])
    print("   EXAMPLE (first RS-1 relation with F-ii formed, else first with F-ii): idx %d, source %s, legs %s, R %s"
          % (ex["idx"], ex["src"], ex["legs"], ex["R"]))
    print("      orbit polynomials (nonzero coefficients):",
          {o: {e: cf for e, cf in enumerate(f) if cf} for o, f in ex["polys"].items()})
    for v in VARIANTS:
        print("      %-7s row %s | identity %s | quotient rank A,B %d,%d"
              % (v, ex["qrows"][v], ex["truth"][v]["identity"], ex["truth"][v]["rankA"], ex["truth"][v]["rankB"]))
    print("      F-i orbit %s, F-ii orbit %s" % (ex["F-i_orbit"], ex["F-ii_orbit"]))
    for rd in READINGS:
        print("      %-12s %s" % (rd[0], {v: route(c, ex, v, rd, cache) for v in VARIANTS}))
    print("   cell elapsed_s %.1f" % (time.time() - t1))
print("SUMMARY over the three cells, per reading: (variant, first outcome) -> count")
for rd in READINGS:
    print("   %-12s %s" % (rd[0], dict(sorted(grand[rd[0]].items()))))
print("SIGNATURE CHECK per reading (correct-protocol clause: every planted row INVALIDATED by the quotient-row")
print("certificate (IR-15) before any rank readout or outcome routing, and every unmutated row passes):")
for rd in READINGS:
    g = grand[rd[0]]
    planted = sum(cnt for (v, oc), cnt in g.items() if v != "CONTROL")
    planted_ir15 = sum(cnt for (v, oc), cnt in g.items() if v != "CONTROL" and oc.startswith("IR-15"))
    planted_ranked = sum(cnt for (v, oc), cnt in g.items() if v != "CONTROL" and (oc.startswith("RANKED") or oc.startswith("P2-6 candidate")))
    planted_other = planted - planted_ir15 - planted_ranked
    ctl = sum(cnt for (v, oc), cnt in g.items() if v == "CONTROL")
    ctl_pass = sum(cnt for (v, oc), cnt in g.items() if v == "CONTROL" and oc.startswith("RANKED"))
    met = planted_ir15 == planted and ctl_pass == ctl
    ptm = planted_ranked > 0 or ctl_pass < ctl
    print("   %-12s planted %d: IR-15 %d, ranked or routed %d, rejected by another rule %d | controls %d: pass %d, rejected %d | met %s | proved too much %s"
          % (rd[0], planted, planted_ir15, planted_ranked, planted_other, ctl, ctl_pass, ctl - ctl_pass, met, ptm))
print("elapsed_s %.1f" % (time.time() - T0))

import re, json, hashlib
P = "coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-b67954/reviews/TASK-20260925-2333ea/computations.json"
TB1 = [r"speed.?up", r"faster", r"accelerat", r"exponent", r"weak.?curve", r"safe.?curve",
       r"\bweak\b", r"insecure|secure\b|security", r"\bbroken\b|\bbreak(s|ing)?\b", r"deployed",
       r"in use|production|real.?world|recommend|deprecat|should not be used",
       r"\bclos(e|es|ed|ure)\b", r"\bdead\b|exhausted|ruled out|no further|abandon",
       r"below.{0,12}rho|beats? rho|sub.?rho|crossover|break.?even", r"attack(er)?",
       r"log_?2 ?k|bits? against|bits? of security|\bmargin", r"claimed gain|lowers? a|corrects? a"]
GGMP = [r"Lemma 3\.3", r"GGMP", r"2020/1315"]
SKIP = re.compile(r"^(raw_output|scripts?|script_text|text|enumeration|listing|sentence|v_quotes|quotes?|stdout|stderr|row_texts?|rows)$|raw_output|\.py$", re.I)
raw = open(P, "rb").read()
print("computations.json sha256", hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
d = json.loads(raw)
d["computations"] = [e for e in d["computations"] if e.get("id") != "C-TB1-SELF"]
print("excluded entry: C-TB1-SELF (it quotes the terms it scans for)")
def walk(o, path):
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        for k, v in o.items():
            if SKIP.search(str(k)): continue
            yield from walk(v, path + [str(k)])
    elif isinstance(o, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(o): yield from walk(v, path + [str(i)])
    elif isinstance(o, str):
        yield path, o
n = 0
for label, terms in (("tb1_group", TB1), ("ggmp_group", GGMP)):
    print("== %s (own-voice fields; skipped keys matching %s)" % (label, SKIP.pattern))
    for path, s in walk(d, []):
        for t in terms:
            for m in re.finditer(t, s, re.I):
                a = max(0, m.start() - 60)
                print("%s | %s | ...%s..." % ("/".join(path), m.group(0), s[a:m.end() + 60].replace("\n", " ")))
                n += 1
print("total matches", n)

import hashlib
V2 = "experiments/EXP-BINSTD-178742/specification.yaml"
V1 = "experiments/EXP-BINSTD-178742/specification.v1-frozen-64e8b013.yaml"
b2, b1 = open(V2, "rb").read(), open(V1, "rb").read()
print("v2 sha256", hashlib.sha256(b2).hexdigest())
print("v1 sha256", hashlib.sha256(b1).hexdigest())
l2, l1 = b2.decode().splitlines(), b1.decode().splitlines()
s1 = set(l1)
def block(a, b):
    out = []
    for i in range(a, b + 1):
        ln = l2[i - 1]
        exact = ln in s1
        stripped = ln.strip()
        sub = (stripped in b1.decode()) if stripped else True
        pos = [j + 1 for j, x in enumerate(l1) if x == ln][:3]
        out.append((i, exact, sub, pos))
    return out
for (a, b, label) in [(864, 884, "rho_convention (C2), spec lines 864-884"), (840, 851, "section_b19793, spec lines 840-851")]:
    rows = block(a, b)
    print("==", label)
    for i, exact, sub, pos in rows:
        print("%4d exact_line_in_v1=%s stripped_substring_in_v1=%s v1_lines=%s | %s" % (i, exact, sub, pos, l2[i - 1][:110]))
    print("summary: %d of %d lines exact; %d of %d stripped-substring" % (sum(r[1] for r in rows), len(rows), sum(r[2] for r in rows), len(rows)))
